paraphrase: Each verse praises the mind — that which goes far while awake and asleep, the light of lights, by which the sacrifice is performed — and prays: 'may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve'.
notes: Refrain 'tan me manaḥ śivasaṅkalpam astu' (Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā 34.1–6).

checks.note: Located in Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā (Mādhyandina) 34.1-6 (raw_etexts vedaH/yajur/vAjasaneyi/mAdhyandinam/saMhitA/TI/34.md): 'yaj jāgrato dūram udaiti … tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu'. Web sources confirm that these six mantras circulate as the Śivasaṅkalpa Upaniṣad.
